title: Rogers' book We Got It From Them

tellings.quote: >> Um to be really ingenious, I decided to call it We Got It From Them. [laughter]

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who has worked with NASA and says he saw a UFO inside a secret hangar, has written a 2025 book about it with a title that makes his point: We Got It From Them. He tells Michels, laughing, that he decided to be "really ingenious" and call it that. The title is his claim in short: if true, some of what the hangar held came from a non-human source.
